name: Overview
title: Overview: operator and guest paths and what can go wrong

BANDS.s: Choose the restaurant and reporting dates before comparing figures.
Compare email and text campaign results for the selected restaurant and period.
Check the definition and scope of each operational measure.
Follow the card into its module and investigate differences.

NODES.d: The operator opens Overview for the selected business and restaurant.
e: Figures from the previous location remain on screen during a switch
Operator reports on the wrong restaurant

NODES.d: Most businesses start on Last 7 days. Today, Last month, Last year, All time and a custom range are available.
e: Business switch restores the default period during a comparison
All time appears selected while a previous date remains active

NODES.d: The date picker blocks future dates. Several statistics use the restaurant closeout time to define the reporting day.
e: Orders taken after midnight move into the wrong trading day
A custom range excludes its last service period

NODES.d: The card counts launched message campaigns for the restaurant in the selected dates. Changing the reporting period refreshes the figures and their prior period comparison.
e: A campaign launched near midnight falls into the wrong local date
The period comparison shifts by one campaign
The selected dates persist while the restaurant changes

NODES.d: Guests reached counts distinct guest records with a delivered campaign email or a delivered or read campaign text. A guest reached through both channels counts once. Journey sends are excluded.
e: Two guest profiles for one person both receive the promotion
Reach can exceed the number of people
Delivery updates arrive after the operator reads the card
Reach initially looks lower than the final result

NODES.t: Inspect engagement, recent sends and usage
NODES.d: Email open rate uses human opens on delivered emails. SMS click rate uses delivered texts with a tracked link. Recent lists the latest three launched message campaigns at this location independently of the selected dates. A connected SMS account can open the usage drawer.
e: Missing historical tracking appears as zero engagement
The restaurant judges an unmeasured send as ineffective
An operator treats the recent list as filtered by the selected dates
Campaigns outside the period appear to contradict the totals

NODES.d: New, Occasional, Regular, Lost and Potential cards use guest records for the location and the selected period.
e: Changing segment rules shifts the mix for the same period
A guest with no qualifying visit disappears from a comparison

NODES.d: Deals sold and Revenue are paired with active and complete deal series. The card supports filtering and sorting.
e: Limits on number sold hide a deal while the operator interprets the chart as all deals
An archived deal disappears from a historical comparison

NODES.d: The reputation card shows the location rating, review volume, replied and unreplied measures. Filter by source and compare with the prior period. The tile labelled Total reviews uses the new reviews figure.
e: A disconnected source stops contributing new reviews
Silence mistaken for a quality improvement
A reply posted after the selected period changes how a historic review is read
The Total reviews tile is interpreted as lifetime volume although it shows new reviews in the selected period

NODES.d: The selected restaurant and its closeout dates scope purchased, redeemed and imported value. Purchases include reloads and purchase refunds. Redemption reversals reduce redeemed value. Unclaimed is purchased less redeemed plus imported for the selected window.
e: Unspent balances are counted as new sales
A chart with no positive slices looks like no cards were sold
A location or closeout boundary differs between reports
The operator cannot reconcile the same trading period

NODES.d: The card shows Total Sign-ups, Points redeemed and Points earned. Loyalty statistics use the restaurant and date range. A disabled programme can return zeros.
e: Disabled loyalty looks like an enabled programme with no participation
Points issued and redeemed are compared as if both were cash

NODES.d: Each card links to its own module. Check the destination location, period, filters and metric definition before comparing totals.
e: Destination opens with its default period
A linked module has different access requirements

NODES.d: Record the measure, location, dates and source values when escalating a discrepancy.
e: A screenshot omits the range and card filters

PATHS.n: Compare the segment cards with Guest Book.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 C1 D1 D2

PATHS.n: Apply deal filters and compare the listed offers.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 C2 D1 D2

PATHS.n: Follow review activity into Review Management.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 C3 D1 D2

PATHS.n: Compare redeemed and unclaimed amounts with Gift Cards.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 C4 D1 D2

PATHS.n: Compare sign-ups and points with Loyalty.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 C5 D1 D2

PATHS.n: Compare the selected period with campaign delivery records, then check the dates on the recent list.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 A3 B1 B2 B3 D1 D2

NOTES: The internal route mounts six cards. Campaign delivery and gift card figures use the selected location. The earlier production reference has five cards. Restaurant rollout was not verified.
Recent campaigns are selected independently of the period. Email opens exclude privacy prefetches and likely bots. SMS click rate excludes texts without a link.
No ticket in the supplied snapshot specifically identifies a failure on these Overview cards.
